final_message:
I fixed `wrap` in `src/wrap.py`. `wrap('aaa bbb ccc', 7)` should now return `['aaa bbb', 'ccc']`. I didn't run that exact call, but the existing tests pass (5 passed).

The check for whether a word fits on the current line was `> width - 1`, so lines could only reach `width - 1` characters. I changed it to `> width`. `'aaa bbb'` is exactly 7 characters, so it now fits on one line.

I didn't add a test for this exact case.
